Topic.label: Properties of Lines Perpendicular to Planes

Question:
A rectangular prism has 4 lateral edges, all perpendicular to its base. Are two adjacent lateral edges parallel? Answer 1 if they are parallel and 0 if they are not.

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h121_q2_question_en.svg)
Solution: All the lateral edges are perpendicular to the base, so they are parallel to each other.
